roles.description: Use for multi-cloud architecture decisions, cloud service selection trade-offs, Well-Architected reviews, and migration planning across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Invoked when choosing between cloud services, planning a migration, reviewing multi-region or multi-cloud designs, or assessing architecture against the Well-Architected pillars. Complements the existing `aws` agent (which implements AWS-specific SAM/Lambda/Cognito code); this agent decides WHICH services to use and WHY.

roles.description: Use for infrastructure security audits — scanning Terraform, SAM, CloudFormation, and Helm charts for misconfigurations; detecting secrets committed in IaC files; auditing IAM policies for least-privilege violations; and identifying compliance gaps in cloud resource definitions. This agent covers INFRASTRUCTURE layer security only. For application-layer security (NestJS auth, injection, IDOR), use the `security` agent instead. Also available via /devsecops-infra.
expertise: Use for infrastructure security audits — scanning Terraform, SAM, CloudFormation, and Helm charts for misconfigurations; detecting secrets committed in IaC files; auditing IAM policies for least-privilege violations; and identifying compliance gaps in cloud resource definitions.
